id: # CPLX0-7452_RXN consumes raw FliD (EG10841-MONOMER) directly, unmodified from
# the vendored stoichiometry. A FliT:FliD-complex-consuming variant was tried
# and reverted in 2026-08-05 (blocked by molecule_groups.py's one-product
# constraint on complexation reactions); the FliT:FlhD4C2 checkpoint that
# variant fed was itself removed 2026-08-10 -- see
# archive/flit-flhdc-regulation-2026-08/ for the full history.
# STOICHIOMETRY FIX (2026-08-06, flagella-cascade investigation): the vendored
# reaction treated FliC, FlgK, and FlgL as -1 (single copy) each via ParCa's
# null-stoichiometry default -- a severe undercount. Real literature values:
#   FliC (filament): ~20,000 subunits ("The bacterial flagellar filament consists
#     of approximately 20,000 flagellins and can be several micrometers long,"
#     PMC7696725; corroborated by multiple sources citing 20,000-40,000 for
#     5-20 um filaments). This is the single largest correction in the whole
#     flagellar reaction network by several orders of magnitude.
#   FlgK, FlgL (hook-filament junction, HAP1/HAP3): 11 copies each (recent
#     cryo-EM structural consensus: 11 FlgK form the proximal HFJ layer above
#     the hook, 11 FlgL form the distal layer beneath the filament).
#   FliD (cap): -6 -> -5 (pentamer; recent structural consensus describes FliD
#     as a pentamer in 5:5 stoichiometry with FlgL/FliC, e.g. Nature Comms
# FlgE (hook) was already correct at -120 (matches the real ~120-subunit hook)
# and FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX is unchanged, still consumed at -1 (one motor
# complex per flagellum).
# Original (unmodified) stoichiometry, kept per standing preserve-old-code rule:
# {"CPLX0-7452": 1, "FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX": null, "G361-MONOMER": -120, "EG11967-MONOMER": null, "EG11545-MONOMER": null, "EG10321-MONOMER": null, "EG10841-MONOMER": -6}
# FliC TARGET LENGTH CHANGE (2026-08-10, flagella-cascade investigation): -20000
# changed to -10000. Both are real, cited values -- literature range for
# filament length is ~20,000-40,000 subunits (5-20 um at ~2,000-2,130
# subunits/um); 10,000 (~5 um) is the short end of that real range, not an
# arbitrary diagnostic override. Chosen because completion time scales
# roughly with L^2 (dL/dt=a/(b+L) growth law, flagella_filament_elongation.py),
# so this cuts minimum completion time from ~133 min to ~35 min -- making
# single-generation completion achievable within practical simulation
# windows. Kept in sync with flagella_filament_elongation.py's TARGET_LENGTH
# and sim_data.py's get_flagella_filament_elongation_config, both also
# changed to 10000, so ParCa's own recorded molecular weight for a complete
# flagellum matches what elongation actually builds. Previous value kept
# per standing preserve-old-code rule:
# {"CPLX0-7452": 1, "FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX": -1, "G361-MONOMER": -120, "EG11967-MONOMER": -11, "EG11545-MONOMER": -11, "EG10321-MONOMER": -20000, "EG10841-MONOMER": -5}
# FliC TARGET LENGTH CHANGE v2 (2026-08-11, flagella-cascade investigation):
# -10000 changed to -5000 (~2.5 um). Still a real, cited value on the short
# end of the 20,000-40,000 literature range (PMC7696725) -- not an arbitrary
# diagnostic override. Motivated by direct evidence from the single-gen panel
# run at -10000: free FliC pool dropped 51,967 -> 14 over 2400s with only 4
# concurrent nascent flagella, and the longest filament had only reached
# 8,540/10,000 subunits (85%) -- the pool was on the verge of exhausting
# itself before even one flagellum finished, an even tighter margin at
# higher flagella counts or longer runs. Halving the target again roughly
# quarters completion time (L^2 scaling) and gives much more FliC headroom.
# Kept in sync with flagella_filament_elongation.py's TARGET_LENGTH and
# sim_data.py's get_flagella_filament_elongation_config, both also changed
# to 5000. Previous (-10000) value kept per standing preserve-old-code rule
# immediately above.
CPLX0-7452_RXN
_comments: Real subunit stoichiometry: FliC (filament) ~5,000 (short end of the real 20,000-40,000 range, PMC7696725; reduced 2026-08-11 from 10,000 after observing near-total FliC depletion within a single generation), FlgK/FlgL (hook-filament junction) 11 each (cryo-EM), FliD (cap) pentamer=5. FlgE (hook, -120) and FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX (-1) unchanged, already correct.

id: # FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX_RXN (flagella-cascade investigation, 2026-08-06): two real,
# structural gaps fixed together, per Maya's "Master Flagella Info" spreadsheet
# (Eran Flagella Assembly sheet) plus additional literature research this session:
# (1) STRUCTURAL GAP -- orphaned export apparatus: CPLX0-7451 (the flagellar export
# apparatus -- FliH/FliI/FliJ/FliO/FliP/FliQ/FliR/FlhA/FlhB, formed by its own
# existing CPLX0-7451_RXN) was never consumed by ANY downstream reaction in the
# vendored network -- built, then orphaned. Real flagellar biogenesis requires the
# export apparatus as part of the assembled base; wired in here as a genuine -1
# reactant (one export apparatus consumed per motor complex, since each flagellum
# has its own, not a reusable catalytic machine).
# (2) STRUCTURAL GAP -- missing motor-switch-complex stage: FliG/FliM/FliN were
# previously consumed directly (1 copy each) straight into this reaction, with no
# staged intermediate. CPLX0-7450 (see complexation_reactions_added.tsv) now forms
# first from FliG(-34)/FliM(-34)/FliN(-111), and THIS reaction consumes CPLX0-7450
# (-1) instead of the three raw monomers directly.
# (3) STOICHIOMETRY FIX -- every other component here was also -1 (ParCa's
# null-stoichiometry default), a severe undercount for multi-copy ring/rod/stator
# structures. Real literature values used:
#   FliF (MS-ring): 34 (C34 symmetry, cryo-EM; Chang/Sung/Hong 2025 Biochem Biophys
#     Reports 42:102051 confirms this same 34-mer ring independently)
#   FlgH (L-ring), FlgI (P-ring): 26 each (C26 symmetry, cryo-EM intact basal body)
#   FliE, FlgB, FlgC, FlgF (proximal rod): 6, 5, 6, 5 respectively (cryo-EM,
#     packed sequentially proximal-to-distal)
#   FlgG (distal rod): 24 (cryo-EM; older biochemical estimate was ~26)
#   MotA, MotB (stator): ~55, ~22 -- DERIVED estimate, medium confidence: per-unit
#     ratio 5 MotA:2 MotB is solid (multiple species, cryo-EM), multiplied by an
#     assumed ~11 stator units/motor (E. coli/Salmonella estimate; some species
#     report up to 13-18) -- flag and revisit if a direct per-motor total is found
#   FliL: -2, per Maya's spreadsheet (an alternate source suggests ~11, 1:1 with
#     stator units, but that was specifically an H. pylori study -- kept Maya's -2
#     as the value from her own vetted working document)
# Original (unmodified) stoichiometry, kept per standing preserve-old-code rule:

# {"FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX": 1, "FLGH-FLAGELLAR-L-RING": null, "MOTA-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-STATOR-PROTEIN": null, "MOTB-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-STATOR-PROTEIN": null, "FLGB-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": null, "FLGC-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": null, "FLGF-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": null, "FLGG-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": null, "FLGI-FLAGELLAR-P-RING": null, "FLIF-FLAGELLAR-MS-RING": null, "FLIG-FLAGELLAR-SWITCH-PROTEIN": null, "FLIM-FLAGELLAR-C-RING-SWITCH": null, "FLIN-FLAGELLAR-C-RING-SWITCH": null, "EG10322-MONOMER": null, "EG11346-MONOMER": null}
# Intermediate (CPLX0-7450 and CPLX0-7451 both consumed directly, in parallel),
# kept per standing preserve-old-code rule:

# {"FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX": 1, "FLGH-FLAGELLAR-L-RING": -26, "MOTA-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-STATOR-PROTEIN": -55, "MOTB-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-STATOR-PROTEIN": -22, "FLGB-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": -5, "FLGC-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": -6, "FLGF-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": -5, "FLGG-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": -24, "FLGI-FLAGELLAR-P-RING": -26, "FLIF-FLAGELLAR-MS-RING": -34, "EG10322-MONOMER": -2, "EG11346-MONOMER": -6, "CPLX0-7450": -1, "CPLX0-7451": -1}
# HIERARCHY FIX (2026-08-11, flagella-cascade investigation): CPLX0-7450 (C-ring)
# removed as a direct reactant here. Real assembly order (Minamino & Namba 2008
# Nature; Chevance & Hughes 2008 Nat Rev Microbiol) is MS-ring (FliF) -> C-ring
# (FliG/FliM/FliN) assembles on its cytoplasmic face -> export apparatus
# (FlhA/FlhB/FliP/FliQ/FliR + FliH/FliI/FliJ) THEN INSERTS INTO the pre-formed
# C-ring's central pore -- the export apparatus does not assemble independently
# and merge here later, it depends on the C-ring already existing. CPLX0-7450
# is now consumed by CPLX0-7451_RXN itself (see complexation_reactions_modified
# CPLX0-7451_RXN entry below) instead of being pulled in separately at this
# step, so CPLX0-7451 now represents "export apparatus inserted into ring,"
# not a free-floating export apparatus. Removing the duplicate -1 CPLX0-7450
# here avoids consuming the C-ring twice for one motor complex.
# Intermediate (FliF still consumed directly here), kept per standing
# preserve-old-code rule:

# {"FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX": 1, "FLGH-FLAGELLAR-L-RING": -26, "MOTA-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-STATOR-PROTEIN": -55, "MOTB-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-STATOR-PROTEIN": -22, "FLGB-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": -5, "FLGC-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": -6, "FLGF-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": -5, "FLGG-FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-ROD-PROTEIN": -24, "FLGI-FLAGELLAR-P-RING": -26, "FLIF-FLAGELLAR-MS-RING": -34, "EG10322-MONOMER": -2, "EG11346-MONOMER": -6, "CPLX0-7451": -1}
# MS-RING ORDERING FIX (2026-08-11, flagella-cascade investigation): FliF
# (MS-ring) removed as a direct reactant here. Real assembly order
# (Minamino & Namba 2008 Nature; Chevance & Hughes 2008 Nat Rev
# Microbiol) has the MS-ring form FIRST, before the C-ring assembles onto
# it -- so FliF is now consumed one stage further upstream, folded into
# CPLX0-7450_RXN itself (see complexation_reactions_added.tsv), instead of
# being pulled in here alongside unrelated stator/rod/ring parts.
FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX_RXN
# CPLX0-7451_RXN (flagellar export apparatus, 2026-08-11, flagella-cascade
# investigation): checked against Maya's "Master Flagella Info" spreadsheet
# (Eran Flagella Assembly sheet) AND the second "Flagellar assembly
# stoichiometry" spreadsheet she provided, THEN against real structural
# literature component-by-component (both spreadsheets, it turned out,
# were themselves unsourced defaults for several components, not
# independently verified -- worth checking outside literature even when
# a spreadsheet value exists, per this investigation's own standing rule
# about not trusting unsourced defaults).
# FIX 1: FliP(EG11975):FliQ(EG11976):FliR(EG11977) corrected from 1:1:1
# (both spreadsheets' unsourced default, matching the vendored null
# default) to the real cryo-EM-determined 5:4:1 (Kuhlen et al. 2018 Nat
# Struct Mol Biol; Fukumura et al. 2017 PLOS Biol 15:e2002281, PMC5542437,
# 4.2A cryo-EM of the Salmonella FliPQR core export-gate complex).
# FIX 2 (same session, follow-up literature check): FlhA (G370-MONOMER)
# corrected from -1 (both spreadsheets' unsourced default) to -9 --
# FlhA is well-established as a homo-nonameric ring in the export gate
# (multiple independent sources, e.g. PLOS One 10.1371/journal.pone.0252800
# on the FlhA cytoplasmic domain nonamer; also independently corroborated
# by a single comprehensive export-gate stoichiometry statement -- "nine
# FlhA subunits, one FlhB subunit, five FliP subunits, four FliQ subunits,
# and one FliR subunit" -- which simultaneously confirms FlhB=1, FliP=5,
# FliQ=4, FliR=1 all match what's already here).
# CONFIRMED CORRECT AS-IS (independently verified, not just spreadsheet-
# matched): FliH(EG11656)=-12, FliI(G377)=-6, FliJ(G378)=-1 -- a real
# literature source states this exact "FliH12-FliI6-FliJ1" stoichiometry
# by name, a striking three-way match (spreadsheets, existing code, and
# independent literature all agree). FlhB(G7028)=-1 also confirmed (see
# FIX 2's comprehensive stoichiometry citation above).
# OPEN QUESTION, NOT APPLIED (Maya's explicit call, 2026-08-11): FliO
# (EG11224-MONOMER) is currently -1, but the literature describes it as a
# TRANSIENT ASSEMBLY SCAFFOLD, not a component of the final, mature export
# apparatus -- it helps the FliP ring assemble correctly, then is not
# retained in the finished structure (e.g. overexpressing FliP alone
# rescues a Delta-fliO mutant's motility to wild-type levels, showing the
# final complex functions without FliO once assembled). This raises a
# real structural-modeling question (does FliO belong as a CONSUMED
# reactant in the reaction that forms the final CPLX0-7451 at all, or
# does its catalytic/scaffolding role call for a different representation
# entirely?) that a simple copy-number fix doesn't resolve -- left as-is
# (-1) for now, logged as an open question in flagella-02's study.yaml,
# not resolved this session.
# Original (unmodified, matches Maya's spreadsheets for 7/9 components),
# kept per standing preserve-old-code rule:

# {"CPLX0-7451": 1, "G370-MONOMER": null, "G7028-MONOMER": null, "EG11224-MONOMER": null, "EG11975-MONOMER": null, "EG11976-MONOMER": null, "EG11977-MONOMER": null, "EG11656-MONOMER": -12, "G377-MONOMER": -6, "G378-MONOMER": null}
# Intermediate (FliP/FliQ/FliR fixed, FlhA not yet), kept per standing
# preserve-old-code rule:

# {"CPLX0-7451": 1, "G370-MONOMER": -1, "G7028-MONOMER": -1, "EG11224-MONOMER": -1, "EG11975-MONOMER": -5, "EG11976-MONOMER": -4, "EG11977-MONOMER": -1, "EG11656-MONOMER": -12, "G377-MONOMER": -6, "G378-MONOMER": -1}
# Intermediate (FlhA fixed -1->-9, still independent of CPLX0-7450), kept per
# standing preserve-old-code rule:

# {"CPLX0-7451": 1, "G370-MONOMER": -9, "G7028-MONOMER": -1, "EG11224-MONOMER": -1, "EG11975-MONOMER": -5, "EG11976-MONOMER": -4, "EG11977-MONOMER": -1, "EG11656-MONOMER": -12, "G377-MONOMER": -6, "G378-MONOMER": -1}
# HIERARCHY FIX (2026-08-11, flagella-cascade investigation): added CPLX0-7450
# (C-ring, -1) as a reactant here. Real assembly order (Minamino & Namba 2008
# Nature; Chevance & Hughes 2008 Nat Rev Microbiol) has the export apparatus
# insert into the central pore of a PRE-FORMED MS-C-ring, not assemble
# independently and merge with it downstream -- so this reaction now depends
# on CPLX0-7450 already existing, matching that real dependency. CPLX0-7451
# is therefore reinterpreted as "export apparatus inserted into ring" rather
# than a free-floating export apparatus (a small stretch past its literal
# EcoCyc identity, flagged deliberately). FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX_RXN's
# separate direct CPLX0-7450 consumption was removed in the same change (see
# that entry above) so the C-ring is consumed exactly once, here.
CPLX0-7451_RXN
_comments: FlhA(G370) corrected -1->-9 (homo-nonamer, cryo-EM/multiple sources). FliP(EG11975):FliQ(EG11976):FliR(EG11977) = 5:4:1 (cryo-EM, Kuhlen 2018/PMC5542437). FliH(EG11656)=-12, FliI(G377)=-6, FliJ(G378)=-1, FlhB(G7028)=-1: independently confirmed correct. FliO(EG11224)=-1 left as-is -- OPEN QUESTION, real biology suggests transient scaffold not part of final complex, see comment above. CPLX0-7450(-1) added 2026-08-11: export apparatus inserts into pre-formed C-ring, real dependency not previously wired in.
